final_summary.diagnostic_explanation: Good-role mismatches: seven soft suspicion votes with no eligible echoers; four claimant fights (three with echoers); three seer fake-claim responses. Hard checks correctly block the latter seven. Five wolf mismatches are untouched.
final_summary.background_table_schema: Each row is [seat wins, [villager wins,n], [seer wins,n], [wolf wins,n]]. Seat n is 100 for seed231, 200 for seed232. B0 and all evaluated candidates have identical values in every cell.

scope: Werewolf only; local scripted development, no production edits, deployment, promotion or model calls
hypothesis: On soft good-role decisions only, keep our latest unambiguous actually published current-day vote when distinct living noncontradicted players subsequently echo it. Never move to a different target merely because others call it.

variants.any_echo: At least one distinct eligible living speaker subsequently publicly commits to our target.
variants.two_echo: At least two distinct eligible living speakers subsequently publicly commit to our target.
variants.credible_echo: At least one eligible echoer is an own/trusted clear or kept a public commitment in one of the previous two recorded votes, using the pre-existing CoordinationPolicy.credible definition.

invariants: Only seer/villager; all wolf policy behavior unchanged.
B0 base decision evaluated first; only its two terminal soft suspicion reason branches eligible.
No known wolf, exposed living liar, claimant fight, own check clear, trusted clear, self or illegal target is overridden.
Own commitment parser sees only actual own broadcasts, actual sender, actual day and alive seats; replacing me with None is parser-only and never used by knowledge/claim helpers.
Ignore private, stale, dead, ambiguous, withdrawn, quoted, negated and injected commitments; deduplicate speakers.
No new chat topics or claims; first public speech, investigations and wolf behavior remain B0.
No opponent identifiers, seed or evaluator world state available to policy.

diagnostic.metric: own declared target versus actual ballot, eligibility and echoes; fixed-other-ballot elimination/faction pivotality, not a counterfactual win claim
diagnostic.traces: up to 6 illustrative cases; streamed compressed evaluator-only raw records

selection.metric: largest paired all-background controlled-seat win delta; ties prefer two_echo, then credible_echo, then any_echo
selection.if_positive: replicate only the top fixed variant
selection.otherwise: replicate only the same closest-to-positive fixed variant as diagnostic; do not invent new variants

safety.full_source_changes: Report all manifest changes; unused sibling local files still invalidate full-source unchanged gate and remain exploratory.
